title: Restricted MDX compiler
responsibility: Compile a stage document to a renderable component at request time using `@mdx-js/mdx`, running the rejection plugin that fails the compile with a file path and a line:column position on any ESM import or export, JavaScript expression, JSX attribute expression, JSX spread attribute, or JSX element outside the permitted component set. Own the pinned compiler and plugin chain.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ REQUEST-TIME, NOT BUILD-TIME, AND THAT IS NOT A PERFORMANCE CHOICE. AST-0030 measured that a file-routed `@next/mdx` page is compiled into the build and does not reflect an edit, which REQ-0018 forbids. Routing stage documents as pages would satisfy REQ-0017 and silently fail REQ-0018 while looking correct. ⚠️ OUTSIDE ITS BOUNDARY: it does not read the document (that is the reader) and does not decide the component vocabulary (that is the mapping it is given). ⚠️ IT OWNS DEC-0020's PINNING OBLIGATION: changing the MDX version or adding any remark, rehype or recma plugin reopens security validation before it ships. The rejection was measured at the remark stage only; a later stage could reintroduce what it refused. ⚠️ BUILT 2026-08-28 BY TSK-0008. `@mdx-js/mdx` pinned at 3.1.1 exactly, one remark plugin, no rehype or recma stage, compiled at request time. ACC-0017 and ACC-0019 pass. ACC-0018 stays `not-evaluated` because it also evaluates CMP-0016, which does not exist until TSK-0009 — the mapped component IS proven to render, by test and in production, but the criterion covers a pair. ⚠️ `format: "mdx"` IS PART OF THE CONTRACT, and AST-0038 is why. Left to infer the format from the path, the compiler parses a `.md` document as plain markdown: components render as bare paragraphs and expressions compile with NO REJECTION, because the parser produces no nodes for the plugin to refuse. The contract goes vacuous, silently, decided by a filename — and it had already made a test pass on all nine real stage documents for the wrong reason. ⚠️ REJECTION IS THE CONTRACT AND STRIPPING SITS UNDERNEATH IT. A test in the suite proves the difference is observable: with the plugin removed the same document compiles and its expression EVALUATES, so a check that only looked for an absent side effect could not tell a refusal from a silent removal. ⚠️ THE DIAGNOSTIC DOES NOT REACH THE BROWSER ON ITS OWN (AST-0039): a refusal surfaces as a 200 and an opaque digest. Catching `StageDocumentRejected` and rendering its path and position is the stage view's obligation.
